message.content: The pain started about two days ago, in the middle of my upper back, between my shoulder blades. It doesn't spread anywhere else, like down my arms or around to my chest. I'm not sure exactly how to describe it, it's just a bad pain in that spot. I don't remember anything that set it off. I didn't have an injury or lift anything heavy. I don't have anything specific to say about movement, coughing or bending making it better or worse. After the pain started, my legs got weaker and weaker until I couldn't stand up.
